research_method_inputs.source: Wei et al., Symbol tuning improves in-context learning in language models, EMNLP 2023, DOI 10.18653/v1/2023.emnlp-main.61
research_method_inputs.implication: Arbitrary-symbol supervision can strengthen use of episode-local input-label mappings; this supports dynamic codebook training as a method direction but is not Qwen3.5-0.8B-specific evidence.

research_method_inputs.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, ICML 2025 / PMLR 267
research_method_inputs.implication: Variable binding can pass through a shallow shortcut phase before systematic routing emerges; checkpoint evaluation must distinguish shortcut success from systematic unseen-symbol/depth/N transfer.

research_method_inputs.source: Sharma, Dawes, Raval, Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers, arXiv:2604.22128
research_method_inputs.implication: Decodability is not sufficient evidence of causal use; Hyperposition/J-Space promotion needs matched behavioral and causal tests.

research_method_inputs.source: Makelov, Lange, Geiger, Nanda, Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for?, ICLR 2024
research_method_inputs.implication: Successful subspace patching can activate a dormant parallel path; causal promotion requires anti-illusion controls, not patching alone.

research_method_inputs.source: Xue et al., Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn, ACL 2026, DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.1393
research_method_inputs.implication: Aggregate convergence can hide systematically unlearned subsets; freeze capability-family checkpoint curves and retention diagnostics.

research_method_inputs.source: Jin et al., CoBA: Counterbias Text Augmentation for Mitigating Various Spurious Correlations via Semantic Triples, EMNLP 2025, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.520
research_method_inputs.implication: Counterfactual/counterbias augmentation supports crossing multiple nuisance factors rather than trusting marginal balance.
